caption: Pixel A (Ix = 2, Iy = 0, It = 1) gives 2u + 1 = 0, so u = −0.5; pixel B (Ix = 0, Iy = 2, It = 1) gives 2v + 1 = 0, so v = −0.5. The two one-component answers join into the flow vector (−0.5, −0.5) of length 0.707 pixels/frame.

spec.title: Two pixels → one flow vector
spec.aria: Pixel A's equation 2u + 1 = 0 gives u = −0.5 and pixel B's equation 2v + 1 = 0 gives v = −0.5; the two answers merge into the flow vector (−0.5, −0.5) with magnitude 0.707 pixels per frame.
